question: What obstacle-causing earth-wandering forces are addressed after chanting one lakh repetitions?
premises: Chanting is performed to the measure of one lakh.
inference: After chanting one lakh repetitions, the obstacle-causing earth-wandering forces are addressed.
uncertainties: The verb governing bhūcaryaḥ vighnakārikāḥ is supplied by context in the next verse.
plain_english: Indeed, having chanted one lakh repetitions, one deals with the obstacle-causing earth-wandering forces.
